Title: Azure Database for MariaDB: New compute options are now generally available

Body.Content:
Azure Database for MariaDB provides a fully managed database service for app development and deployment with built-in capabilities, such as high availability, at no extra cost. Azure Database for MariaDB now supports scaling up compute to 64 vCores in the general purpose pricing tiers and 32 vCores in the memory optimized tiers. With this increase in compute, the service supports even larger workloads and helps you to accommodate future growth.

For more information, see the Azure Database for MariaDB pricing page.

Visit the Azure Database for MariaDB pricing page

Learn more about Azure Database for MariaDB
